This thread includes three participation tasks.

Participation B: Test Deepseek-v3.2 on HW10 Problem1

Participation E: HTML illustration on Multi-head Attention with Gemini3 pro

Participation E: Explain SSM with Lecture Notes and Extracted Subtitles

1. Participation B: Test Deepseek-v3.2 on HW10 Problem 1

The homework problem provides a Jupyter Notebook with detailed instructions and hints. With the PDF file of the notebook, Deepseek-v3.2 (with DeepThink) takes 152s for thinking and generates a formatted answer. This says that the model has the ability to extract text from the file, analyse the coding problem, and produce a neat answer.

Link: https://chat.deepseek.com/share/kvr8rcp0a391qia2xl

2. Participation E: HTML illustration on Multi-head Attention with Gemini3 pro

I was reviewing problem 3 from HW9 (Ordinary Softmax Multihead Attention Implementation) and was confused about the dimensions, especially when it comes to 4 dimensions. So I thought it might be helpful to create a diagram with LLM. 

Gemini Pro created a simple HTML page with a PowerPoint-like illustration, with minimal interaction.

3. Participation E: Explain SSM with Lecture Notes and Extracted Subtitles

In this section, I used Gemini to interact with lecture notes and YouTube subtitle (a big thank to Yubo Fan) on State Space Models (SSMs). Gemini guided me through the material, pausing to check my understanding and adjusting its explanations based on my responses. I also generate a neat handout in LaTeX to summarize our conversation.
